text:
raj: FYI customer ACME reported a gap in audit events while validating an admin role change during an incident. They see rbac_change events but some are missing `target_user_id` and `request_id`. Need to confirm schema coverage and whether KMS decrypts are logged. Anyone available?

anya: I'm on it. Which env? prod/dedicated? :eyes:

raj: prod: acme-enterprise-us-east. Customer timestamp for the action: 2026-03-15T21:04:12Z. They provided an exported event bundle that shows 3 rbac_change events.

maya: I can pull from audit.raw_events. quick check first.

maya: query I'm running: `select event_id, event_type, payload->>'action', payload->>'target_user_id', meta->>'request_id' from audit.raw_events where org='acme-enterprise-us-east' and event_time between '2026-03-15' and '2026-03-16' and event_type like 'rbac_%';`

maya: results: 3 rbac_change events. Only 1/3 has target_user_id. request_id present in meta for 2/3. looks like older schema in play for some entries.

sam: KMS decrypts are recorded in kms.audit_ops. We should correlate by request_id if present; fallback is session_id + time-window.

anya: can you paste redacted samples so I can prepare customer evidence?

maya: redacted sample 1:
--
{ event_id: 'evt_0a1b', event_type: 'rbac_change', event_time: '2026-03-15T21:04:12Z', payload: { action: 'grant_role', role: 'admin' }, meta: { actor: 'alice@acme.com' } }
--
sample 2 (has request_id):
--
{ event_id: 'evt_0a1c', event_type: 'rbac_change', event_time: '2026-03-15T21:04:12Z', payload: { action: 'grant_role', role: 'admin', target_user_id: 'user_42' }, meta: { actor: 'alice@acme.com', request_id: 'req_9f7' } }
--

raj: ok. customer expects every grant_role to include target_user_id + request_id. do we have a schema version mismatch?

maya: schema history: v1.0 (2024-08) no request_id, v1.3 (2025-11) added request_id, v1.4 (2026-02) made target_user_id required for `grant_role`. rollout for v1.4 to Dedicated clusters was staggered; some clusters still on v1.2.

sam: ACME is Dedicated. infra-bot can confirm their control-plane version.

infra-bot: @sam ACME-prod cluster running control-plane v1.2.4, agent v1.2.4 (last upgrade 2026-02-10).

anya: that explains missing fields. sam, can you check kms.audit_ops for the same timeframe and look for a decrypt with request_id `req_9f7`?

sam: running: `select op_id, op_type, key_id, requester, meta->>'request_id', ts from kms.audit_ops where org='acme-enterprise-us-east' and ts between '2026-03-15T21:00:00Z' and '2026-03-15T21:10:00Z';`

sam: found one decrypt: { op_id: 'kms_77', op_type: 'decrypt', key_id: 'key_acme_1', requester: 'service/redwood-inference@infra', meta.request_id: 'req_9f7', ts: '2026-03-15T21:04:13Z' }

raj: great — even though one rbac_change lacked request_id, we have a kms op with req_9f7 matching the other event. can we build a timeline?

maya: reconstructed timeline (redacted):
- 21:04:12Z evt_0a1c rbac_change grant_role target_user user_42 (req_9f7)
- 21:04:13Z kms_77 decrypt key_acme_1 (req_9f7) by service/redwood-inference@infra
- 21:04:15Z access logs show model endpoint call by user_42 (redacted request id matched by session window)

anya: I'll assemble the customer packet: redacted event snippets, schema timeline, infra deployment note, and the reconstructed timeline.

raj: mitigation proposals: 1) update customer-facing docs to state expected coverage per schema version and the staggered rollout; 2) offer upgrade slot for ACME's control-plane to guarantee v1.4 coverage; 3) consider backfill for missing request_ids where correlation is high-confidence.

maya: backfill is best-effort only — we can try to correlate by session_id + timestamps and generate synthetic request_ids in the backfilled records, but must label them as reconstructed. I'll draft the wording.

sam: also proposing an internal monitor: alert if `grant_role` events missing `target_user_id` exceed threshold for a cluster. open a ticket for eng-platform.

raj: please open a postmortem-lite and include eng-platform + infra.

compliance-bot: Ticket created: CMP-2026-314 - Audit Schema Coverage Investigation - assignees: maya, sam, raj. Link: https://rwd.internal/t/CMP-2026-314

anya: thanks all — pinging legal for any DSR/notice language.

maya: one more ask: confirm retention for audit.raw_events for Dedicated — infra-bot?

infra-bot: Audit retention for Dedicated customers: 365d by default, configurable per contract.

raj: closing loop: I'll send the draft to the customer by EOD and propose the upgrade slot. :thumbsup:
